en: Black‑and‑white photograph of a large late‑19th‑century red‑brick institutional building with several long wings and three to four stories, set behind a fence and young trees. The architecture is sober and functional, with regularly spaced tall windows, simple cornices and a tiled, moderately pitched roof with many lightning rods. In the foreground is an open square or parade ground where groups of men in dark jackets and light trousers stand and converse; one man on horseback passes along the front of the building. The overall scene suggests a military barracks, academy, or other government complex. No printed caption or other text is visible on the image.
